## 2026-10-11T11:00Z — separate Labs discovery from local SEO evidence

- Re-read Nifty parent `4z3VTZ1Lto` immediately before this update; it remains active and unarchived.
- Root cause confirmed against the exact private report: related-keyword discovery was sent at city granularity even though DataForSEO Labs locations are country-level. The implementation also risked treating those country-level suggested metrics as local city demand. Official endpoint documentation supports country-level locations and exposes related-keyword search volume/CPC/competition, difficulty, and intent as discovery data.
- Changed the recovery path: normalize the Labs location to the country component, use it for service-bound related-phrase discovery, then remeasure up to three candidates per uncovered service in one batched Google Ads call at the confirmed primary city. Only city-local Google Ads volume/CPC/competition can fill those metric fields; returned Labs difficulty/intent keep distinct source and country-level location metadata. Unremeasured candidates remain discovery evidence and do not complete SEO readiness.
- Updated SEO research documentation to describe the country-discovery/local-remeasurement boundary.
- TDD: the public `researchSiteContext` test was observed failing on the old Madison Labs call, then passed after the change. It asserts national discovery values (volume 40/CPC 2.1/competition 0.6) remain separate from local values (volume 17/CPC 1.75/competition 0.42), field-level provenance, service-bound filtering, city-local SERP selection, readiness mapping, and the $0.25 cap.
- Focused suites passed 143/143 across SEO research/readiness and test-profile runner/policy.
- Pending: full `npm test`, root/client Astro checks/builds, CodeRabbit re-review, push, and exact-head private cloud rerun. No merge, client deployment, or public preview.
